text:
Noah: Is it just me or does the new Keurig have better posture than I do? :coffee:
Alex: It's judging our 'just one more' refills. :eyes:
Maria: Honestly, I think it has an MBA. Starts meetings on time.
Jamie: Poll: Sacrifice a donut to the coffee gods or unplug and plead for mercy? React :donut: for sacrifice, :plug: for unplug.
Maria: :donut: from me. also leaving a Post-it that says 'we tried'.
Alex: @Jamie I vote bribe. Also I'm bringing maple bars.
OpsBot: heads-up: Kitchen sensor reported 2 small spills this week. Janitor pinged. :broom:
Noah: Perfect — by the time the janitor arrives the coffee will have negotiated a union.
Jamie: Meme incoming in 5...4...3...
Alex: :tada: (attached GIF: tiny coffee cup with sunglasses)
Maria: This is the hill I will die on: coffee > everything. :raised_hands:
Noah: Agreed. If the machine learns to make oat lattes it's basically CEO.
Jamie: Bonus point to whoever names the machine. Suggestions: 'Latte Larry', 'Sir Sips-a-Lot', 'Bean There'.
Alex: Bean There is cursed. Latte Larry is canonical.
Maria: Name it 'Latte Larry' and start a small office terrace with business cards.
Noah: Meeting scheduled 3pm: inauguration and ribbon-cutting. Bring cake.
OpsBot: calendar event created: 'Latte Larry Naming Ceremony' — 3:00 PM today. Invites sent to kitchen crew.
Alex: :wave: See you there. I'll bring a tiny flag.
